determinism.compared: every predictions/*.csv and selection_digest.txt, byte for byte; evaluation.json is excluded only because it records a wall clock

gain_attribution_diagnostic.conclusion: the fitting-side-fitted per-type tail vector carries the gain; the raw crossed product without it is not significant against the protected release
gain_attribution_diagnostic.recipe: nested X2full, varying ONLY the tail transformation

in_sample_ceilings.conclusion: the general-vs-rank-one question has an in-sample ceiling an order of magnitude below this evaluation noise floor, pooled and blockwise
in_sample_ceilings.rank_one_multistart_checked: 7 deterministic starts, best was the uniform start
in_sample_ceilings.what: deliberately leaky, fitted and scored on all 96 episodes; NOT forecasts

independent_rescore.agrees_with_harness_to: all 9 arms, exact to 9 decimal places in points
independent_rescore.scorer: organizer slot_forecasting.contest.contest_score called directly, bypassing slot_model.harness

leak_test_result: arm       fold0 held (must be IDENTICAL) folds1-3 (must CHANGE)

nesting_leak_test.design: the real main() run twice on a reduced grid, differing only in a permutation of the TRUTH of the fold-0 held episodes
nesting_leak_test.requirement_a: fold 0's own held forecasts byte-identical (fitted on folds 1-3)
nesting_leak_test.requirement_b: folds 1-3's held forecasts must CHANGE, otherwise the perturbation never reached the pipeline and the test is vacuous

null_calibration.conclusion: the fitting machinery does not manufacture a gain from no signal
null_calibration.design: the same nested recipe fitted against a global permutation of the truth, then scored against the REAL targets

objective_identity.claim: b.row_weights(mask) weighted full-vector SSE equals the official R on exactly those episodes, so every QP minimises the official objective and not a surrogate

certified_frank_wolfe_duality_gap.definition: f(x) - f* <= g'x - min_j g_j with g = 2Gx, scaled by max diag G
certified_frank_wolfe_duality_gap.rank_one_fits: 1.3e-04 to 1.6e-03, which is NOT solver error: it measures how far the rank-one point sits from the general optimum, i.e. the restriction being tested

feasibility.note: weights are exactly zero off support; the uniform point is always feasible so the QP is never infeasible

tail_transformation_held_fixed.conclusion: the convex mixture provably inherits the per-type tail ratio, so no second projection is applied anywhere in this family
